coreAtributes.authorTag: Faintly raised lettering on each pad reads "Official Enforcer Issue, MFD by DSG Threadworks."
coreAtributes.name: Enforcer's tactical kneepads
coreAtributes.description: A set of hard plastic plates that protect the wearer's knees.

replacementText.self: [npc.Name] slip the tactical kneepads over [npc.her] knees and tighten the straps.
replacementText.other: [npc.Name] slip the tactical kneepads over [npc2.namePos] knees and tighten the straps.
replacementText.otherRough: [npc.Name] stuff [npc2.namePos] legs through the tactical kneepads and hastily tighten the straps.

displacementText.self: [npc.Name] loosen the straps on [npc.her] tactical kneepads and slip them off.
displacementText.other: [npc.Name] loosen the straps on [npc2.namePos] tactical kneepads and slip them off.
displacementText.otherRough: [npc.Name] tear at the straps on [npc2.namePos] tactical kneepads until they're loose enough and toss them aside.
